Definition: properly, to boil up, i.e. (figuratively) to be peevish or angry
BiblicalUsage: 1) to fret, be sad, be wroth, be vexed, be enraged, be out of humour; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be out of humour; 1a2) to be enraged, be angry; 2) (Qal); 2a) to appear perplexed, appear troubled; 2b) to be sad-looking
